title: Pack test case
description: templates/<pack>/tests/<case>/case.json: optional settings of a pack test case.

description.description: What the case shows; the test report prints it.

model.description: Another case of the same pack whose project files (maquettiste.json, model/, extensions/, locales) serve as this case's project. That case must not itself name a model.

parameters.description: Parameters merged over packs.<pack>.parameters of the case's maquettiste.json for the pack under test.
